cpi_yoy_pct_source: MoSPI CPI October 2026 press release, 12 Nov 2026 (provisional): 6.09% y/y, food 8.94%
repo_rate_pct_source: RBI MPC resolution, 7 Oct 2026: repo hiked 25bp to 5.50% (SDF 5.25%, MSF/Bank Rate 5.75%), stance 'calibrated tightening' — rbi.org.in press release
supply_gap_pct_source: IEA Oil Market Report, 13 Nov 2026: Q4-26 supply 105.0 vs demand 103.3 mb/d = 1.7 mb/d surplus (-1.65% of demand). EIA STEO, 10 Nov 2026 corroborates: 1.46 mb/d Q4-26 surplus. Negative = surplus, per this schema.
earnings_growth_pct_source: FY27 consensus Nifty net-income growth ~14% (HSBC India Q2FY27 review, 20 Nov 2026); MOFSL 16%, Kotak Institutional Equities 17.9% — range 14-18%
policy_tone_source: Hawkish: RBI moved stance to 'calibrated tightening' on 7 Oct 2026 and CPI breached the 6% upper band in Oct 2026; economists expect 50-75bp more hikes to a 6.00-6.25% terminal rate (Business Standard, 16 Nov 2026)
insider_tone_source: Promoters net sold Rs 252 Cr on the open market in the 30 days to 19 Nov 2026 (Rs 1,241 Cr bought by 148 insiders vs Rs 1,494 Cr sold by 43) — SEBI/NSE-BSE filings via DocStoX
notes: Only sourced values are pre-filled. Null means not observed; the graph reduces confidence instead of guessing.
repo_rate_pct carries an as-of date of 7 Oct 2026; the next MPC decision is 4 Dec 2026.
The rate channel uses the *change* between snapshots, so it contributes nothing until a later snapshot exists; the level itself is recorded here and in the snapshot.
supply_gap_pct is signed: + = deficit (demand > supply), - = surplus. Q4-26 is in surplus on both IEA and EIA numbers.
acquisition_score stays 0.0: no deal-breadth source was available, so nothing is invented.
acquisition_score / policy_tone / insider_tone are -1..1 event scores written by the aggregator or a human.
